company_facts:
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:30, hybrid (2 days a week in the Leeds office).
Pay: £34,000 to £38,000 a year.
Benefits: 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, pension matched up to 5%.
Team: 8 support advisers, reporting to the Head of Customer Experience.
Process: this interview, then a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager, then an offer. Most people hear back within 5 working days.

anchors.1: Describes reacting to problems as they come, with no example of guiding or developing others.
anchors.3: Gives an example of coaching an adviser or sharing work fairly, with a clear action and some result.
anchors.5: Gives specific examples of developing several people, setting expectations and following up, with measurable results for the team.

competencies.description: Guides and develops a small team so that it works well together.
competencies.name: Leading a team
competencies.source: Lead a team of 8 support advisers day to day.

anchors.1: Handles difficult customers by passing them on, or can't describe what they did.
anchors.3: Describes calming a difficult customer and resolving the issue, with the steps taken.
anchors.5: Describes resolving a complex complaint end to end, balancing the customer's needs with policy, and preventing it from happening again.

competencies.description: Resolves difficult customer situations calmly and fairly.
competencies.name: Handling difficult customers

anchors.1: Mentions numbers without saying how they were used.
anchors.3: Uses one or two measures (response time, satisfaction) to spot a problem and change something.
anchors.5: Uses several measures to find causes, makes changes and shows the effect on the measures.

competencies.description: Uses support measures to find and fix problems.
competencies.name: Using data to improve
competencies.source: Report weekly on response times and satisfaction, and improve them.

eligibility.text: Do you have the right to work in the UK for this role?
The role is hybrid, with 2 days a week in our Leeds office. Does that work for you?

job_description: Customer Support Team Lead (Leeds, hybrid). Lead a team of 8 support advisers day to day. Handle escalated complaints. Report weekly on response times and satisfaction, and improve them. £34,000 to £38,000.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you helped someone in your team get better at their job. What did you do?
Tell me about the most difficult customer situation you've handled. What happened, and what did you do?
Imagine response times in your team have got worse for three weeks in a row. What would you do?

settings.next_steps: The hiring team reviews every interview and will contact you within 5 working days.

summary: A team lead for an 8-person customer support team: coaching advisers, handling escalated complaints and improving response times and satisfaction.
title: Customer Support Team Lead
